description: Specify whether or not contacts are created when pieces overlap (off by default). If the type keyword is not given then it applies to all contact types.

keywords.name: type
keywords.syntax: type {ball-ball | ball-facet | ball-pebble | ball-rblock | pebble-facet | pebble-pebble | pebble-rblock | rblock-facet | rblock-rblock} ...
keywords.description: Apply the setting to one or more specific contact types instead of all of them.

examples.description: Create contacts for all overlapping pieces

notes: The live parser is laxer than the manual: the bare form (no boolean), 'type' with no pair, and an unknown type token are all accepted silently on 9.8.
No state difference was observed in a simple probe (two overlapping balls, then model clean): one contact formed whether the setting was on or off.
The manual's type-keyword description is copied from contact detection; here the type list selects which contact types the create-on-overlap setting applies to.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on the PFC2D/PFC3D 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): the on/off and type forms accepted on both; create-on-overlap is absent from the 6.00/7.00 contact enumerations. A two-overlapping-ball probe formed 1 contact at model clean with the setting both off and on.
